questions.question: A bricklayer is cutting concrete block and visible dust is spreading through the work area. What is the best control?
options: Use water control or dust extraction
questions.explanation: Masonry cutting can create harmful silica dust. Water control or dust extraction reduces airborne dust exposure.

questions.category: Task 2 — Uses and Maintains Tools and Equipment
questions.question: What is the purpose of cleaning a trowel after use?
questions.explanation: Hardened mortar makes tools difficult to use. Clean tools improve workmanship and tool life.

questions.question: What is the safest way to access a scaffold platform?
options: Use the proper ladder or stair access
questions.explanation: Proper scaffold access reduces fall risk. Cross braces and frames are not designed as ladders.

questions.question: Why should materials be placed close to the work area but away from walkways?
options: To reduce handling and maintain safe access
questions.explanation: Good material placement improves efficiency. Clear walkways reduce trips and allow emergency access.

questions.category: Task 5 — Uses Communication and Mentoring Techniques
questions.question: A supervisor gives unclear instructions about wall layout. What should the apprentice do?
options: Ask questions and confirm the instruction
questions.explanation: Clarifying instructions prevents mistakes. Good communication is important for safe and accurate work.
